## What you can do with this camera { #features }

Features as each project describes them, with their status. Follow a project's own guide before installing anything.

<div class="feature-grid" markdown="1">

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Color Profiles 1–3 and Monochrome Profiles 1–3** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Six hidden Picture Mode slots restored after Color Creator.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Custom looks** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Up to ten looks from LookLab in one LOOKS.BIN; the trash button steps through them and the look's name is shown.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Colour editor** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Hue, saturation and lightness for 12 colours, with a tone curve, Sharpness, Contrast and Shading.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**White balance per profile** <span class="pill pill-testing">Testing</span>
{ .feature-head }

The mode, Kelvin and shift are kept for each Color Profile. Not yet checked on a camera.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Monochrome Profiles** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Colour filter, toning, grain and tone, with the filter graphic restored in alpha12.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Live ND32 and ND64** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Two stronger Live ND settings after ND16.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Black and White tone controls** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Per-profile Black and White (−7..+7) on the tone-curve page of Color Profiles 1–3; INFO steps Hi/Sh, Black/White and Mid. Live view updates without a half-press. Covered by the overall owner report.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.2.0-alpha1
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Split toning on the colour wheel** <span class="pill pill-alpha">Alpha</span>
{ .feature-head }

Shadow, Midtone and Highlight Tint for Color Profiles 1–3, each one of 12 colours; INFO switches the wheel between HSL and Tint. Covered by the overall owner report.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.2.0-alpha1
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Film Grain for Color Profiles** <span class="pill pill-research">Research</span>
{ .feature-head }

Removed before v0.2.0-alpha1. A development build showed no grain on the camera at any level; the stock grain pass is monochrome-only, so colour grain needs image-pipeline work on an experiment branch.

[Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.2.0-dev
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Korean menus** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

Korean language support on several bodies.

**dbv0.4.3 · The project reports that this build does not work on this camera.** [Read release notes](https://github.com/azqeurio/om-c-firmware/releases/tag/dbv0.4.3).
{ .release-warning }

[db firmware / om-c-firmware](../projects/db-firmware.md#for-om5-ii)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Hybrid Shutter** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

Switches to the electronic shutter on overexposure in P or A mode and, since v0.4.3, below the slowest mechanical speed in S or M mode. v0.4.3 lists nine bodies, including the OM-3, OM-5, OM-5 Mark II and E-P7; its OM-5 and OM-5 Mark II builds are listed as not working.

**dbv0.4.3 · The project reports that this build does not work on this camera.** [Read release notes](https://github.com/azqeurio/om-c-firmware/releases/tag/dbv0.4.3).
{ .release-warning }

[db firmware / om-c-firmware](../projects/db-firmware.md#for-om5-ii) · since dbv0.4.2
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Card-loaded core and modules** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

A one-time loader patch starts OMKIT\CORE.BIN from the card on every power-on. Updates are file copies; no card, or OK held at power-on, gives a stock camera.

[OMKit](../projects/omkit.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Creative profiles (CREATPRF)** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Three colour and three monochrome profiles in the picture mode strip, edited in the camera's own column (12-sector saturation, tone curve, filter, toning, grain); applied to stills, live view and video.

[OMKit](../projects/omkit.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Film look (FILMLOOK)** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

One picture mode, i-Enhance by default, becomes a film look; the dials step through .ISP presets on the card, 32 bundled, with a tone curve per preset and grain on stills.

[OMKit](../projects/omkit.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Module SDK** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

A public API table, headers and an example module HELLO for writing modules that load from the card.

[OMKit](../projects/omkit.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Preset programs** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

ISP player, ISP fitter (.cube look to preset) and ISP neurofit (preset from RAW files and film scans, driven by an AI agent), run on a computer.

[OMKit](../projects/omkit.md#for-om5-ii) · since v0.1.0
{ .card-meta }

</div>

</div>

## Platform and built-in features (om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100) { #platform }

What the stock firmware itself contains, separate from what projects add. Follow an entry for its sources.

| | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [Image processor generation](../reference/om5-ii-1100.image-processor.md) | TruePic IX | Single source |
| [Main CPU](../reference/om5-ii-1100.main-cpu.md) | MN103/AM33-2, cores CPU0 to CPU2 | Single source |
| [ARM co-processor](../reference/om5-ii-1100.arm-coprocessor.md) | Cortex-A9, Linux 5.10 | Single source |
| [Image memory class](../reference/om5-ii-1100.memory-class.md) | 1 GB (same layout as the OM-5) | Single source |
| [Update file magic](../reference/om5-ii-1100.container-magic.md) | OE 14 80 | Single source |
| [Firmware blocks](../reference/om5-ii-1100.firmware-blocks.md) | 5 | Single source |
| [Main program compression](../reference/om5-ii-1100.main-compression.md) | Two LZ4 sections | Single source |
| [Wi-Fi chip](../reference/om5-ii-1100.wifi-chip.md) | CYW43439 | Single source |
| [Live ND](../reference/om5-ii-1100.native-nd.md) | Native: ND2 to ND16; ND32 to ND128 strings are shared UI only | Single source |
| [USB webcam (UVC)](../reference/om5-ii-1100.native-uvc-webcam.md) | Native | Single source |
| [Live GND](../reference/om5-ii-1100.native-live-gnd.md) | Partial: Settings and UI only; the shooting API methods are empty stubs | Single source |
| [Handheld High Res Shot](../reference/om5-ii-1100.native-hhhr.md) | Native: Jobs 14 and 15 changed from the OM-5 | Single source |
| [Starry Sky AF](../reference/om5-ii-1100.native-starry-sky-af.md) | Native: Adds start triggers | Single source |
| [AI subject detection AF](../reference/om5-ii-1100.native-subject-detect.md) | Dormant code: Code and menu present, not reachable | Single source |
